note: Re-judged 2026-10-11 by an independent judge; row widened to the Identifier item head, obligation 'In a response message, this octet MUST be set to match the identifier in the corresponding request' (RFC 7296 3.16). TestEapfmtResponseIdentifierMatchesRequest drives the EAP peer through Identity, MS-CHAPv2 Challenge and Success with identifiers 200, 7 and 91 and requires each response to echo exactly, so a constant or a counter fails. Peer methods other than MS-CHAPv2 are not sampled. No discrimination record.
